claims.head: Bruisers against finesse
claims.body: On physicality, Ottawa is one of the league’s best, but Nashville is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect most of the big hits to come from the Senators.

claims.head: Forecheck against patience
claims.body: The Senators hound the puck, but the Predators sit back. Ottawa is one of the league’s best for forecheck pressure, and Nashville is near the bottom. Expect the Senators to win more pucks back deep in the Predators’ end.

OTT.head: The matchup suits the Senators
OTT.body: Ottawa has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Predators’ way back in is keeping dangerous shots away.

NSH.head: The Predators face a real test
NSH.body: Ottawa has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Predators can pull it off if they keep dangerous shots away.
